Prospecto utilise les informations néces: Prospecto uses the information required for prospecting, routes and sales follow-up. This page clearly explains the main data processed, the technical services used and the controls available to you.
Prospecto est une application Digital So: Prospecto is a Digital Solutions AI application, Marseille • France. For questions about the app, data or exercising your rights: contact@digitalsolutionsai.com.
Selon les fonctions que vous utilisez, P: Depending on the features you use, Prospecto may process account information, prospects you create or select, routes, appointments, notes, statuses, follow-ups, reports and organisation information required for Business mode. Limited technical data may also be used to secure the service and remember your access or subscription rights.
La recherche de prospects et de lieux s’: Prospect and place search relies in part on OpenStreetMap data and related services such as Nominatim and Overpass. Search requests may include an area, address or coordinates. Opening a route may then use an external mapping application chosen on your device.
Prospecto utilise des services technique: Prospecto uses technical services required to operate the app: Firebase/Google for authentication, data and certain server functions; Google Play for in-app purchases; Google AdMob for advertising in the free version; OpenStreetMap/Nominatim/Overpass for geographic search; and Stripe for certain Business plans when that purchase flow is used.
La version gratuite peut afficher des pu: The free version may display ads. Advertising privacy choices can be opened from Settings when available. Premium users do not receive ads in Prospecto. Paid plans also unlock the limits and features included in the selected plan.
Dans un espace Entreprise, certaines don: In a Business workspace, certain sales data may be shared with authorised members according to their role. Company prospects, assigned routes, appointments and reports are used to provide the sales management features included in the plan and permissions configured by the administrator.
Vous pouvez modifier les informations ac: You can edit information available in the app, manage advertising privacy choices when offered, and request account deletion from Settings. You can also request access, correction, deletion, restriction or objection where these rights apply by contacting Digital Solutions AI.
